Definition: from G5141; a "trembling", i.e. quaking with fear:--+ tremble(-ing).
BiblicalUsage: trómos names a trembling. It appears 5 times in Scripture, including Mark 16:8 and Philippians 2:12.
TheologicalSignificance: My position: trómos carries the precision of a God who says what He means.
